;Arts and culture
*[[2018 Washington Veterans Day Parade]]
**The [[United States Department of Defense]] postpones [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s military parade, which was slated to take place on 10 November, until 2019. The estimates for the parade's cost have risen from $12 million to $92 million. [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/trumps-military-parade-estimated-cost-92-million/story?id=57218363 (ABC News)] [https://www.marketwatch.com/story/pentagon-delays-trumps-big-military-parade-until-at-least-2019-2018-08-16 (Market Watch)]
*[[Freedom of the press in the United States]]
**In [[Concentration_of_media_ownership|coordinated]] [[editorial]]s defending [[Freedom of the press|press freedom]], hundreds of [[List of newspapers in the United States|U.S. newspapers]] rebuke [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s repeated accusations that the news media reports "[[fake news]]" and that journalists are "[[Enemy of the people|enemies of the people]]". [https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2018/0816/985420-trump/ (RTÉ News)]
* American [[Soul music|soul singer]] and songwriter [[Aretha Franklin]] dies at the age of 76. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/08/16/entertainment/aretha-franklin-dead/index.html (CNN)]
;Business and economy
*[[Constellation Brands]], the owner of [[Corona Beer]], announces plans to invest in [[Canada|Canadian]] [[marijuana]] producer Canopy Growth. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-45204186 (BBC)]
;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 California wildfires]]
**Analysis shows that a rare [[Fire whirl|fire tornado]] that barreled into the city of [[Redding, California|Redding]] on July 26 during the [[Carr Fire]] was responsible for the death of a firefighter as he raced towards a neighborhood in flames. [http://www.latimes.com/local/lanow/la-me-ln-fire-tornado-redding-20180816-story.html (''Los Angeles Times'')]
*[[2018 Kerala floods]]
**Authorities in [[India]] say that 350 people are confirmed dead in the heavy floods in [[Kerala]]. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/kochi/kerala-floods-live-updates-more-ndrf-teams-rushed-to-kerala-as-flood-situation-worsens/liveblog/65403405.cms (''Times of India'')]
;Law and crime
*[[Mexican Drug War]]
**The Mexican government announces that they are offering up to MXN$30 million (equivalent to US$1.56 million) for anyone who provides information that leads to the arrest of [[Nemesio Oseguera Cervantes]] (alias "El Mencho"), the suspected leader of the [[Jalisco New Generation Cartel]] and one of Mexico's most-wanted. [http://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/seguridad/el-mencho-el-capo-por-el-que-mexico-ofrece-15-mdd-de-recompensa (''El Universal'')]
*The government of [[DR Congo]] issues an international arrest warrant for opposition leader [[Moïse Katumbi]], who was hoping to take part in the upcoming [[Democratic Republic of the Congo general election, 2018|December 2018 Congolese general election]]. [https://zambiareports.com/2018/08/17/drc-issue-arrest-warrant-katumbi/ (Zambia Reports)]
;Politics and elections
*[[Elections in Canada]], [[Premiership of Justin Trudeau]]
**[[Prime Minister of Canada|Canadian Prime Minister]] [[Justin Trudeau]] dismisses speculation that he would call an early election this fall and states that his government remains focused on renegotiating [[North American Free Trade Agreement|NAFTA]] and strengthening the [[Economy of Canada|economy]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-canada-politics/canadas-trudeau-rules-out-early-election-this-fall-idUSKBN1L123I (Reuters)]
*[[Dog meat consumption in South Korea]]
**Animal rights groups hold protests against dog meat consumption in [[Seoul]]. [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2018/08/17/Animal-rights-groups-protest-dog-meat-consumption-in-Seoul/4561534470906/ (UPI)]
*Amid controversy, the [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump Administration]] of the [[United States]] revokes the [[security clearance]] of former [[CIA]] chief [[John O. Brennan|John Brennan]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-45203277 (BBC)]
;Sports
*[[2018 Major League Baseball season]]
**The [[Texas Rangers (baseball)|Texas Rangers]] pull off a [[triple play]] against the [[Los Angeles Angels]] without retiring the batter, the first such triple play in [[Major League Baseball|MLB]] since 1912. [https://www.huffingtonpost.com/entry/texas-rangers-pull-a-rare-triple-play-not-seen-in-106-years_us_5b76cd4fe4b05906b412e9dd (''HuffPost'')]
